key_findings.detail: Receiver Arm A recovered all 12 operational relations without encountering a single bespoke TD613 or theoretical noun, proving that the relations are not linguistic artifacts.

Receiver Arm B recovered all 12 relations using standard systems engineering concepts from the frozen September Wendbine corpus, demonstrating semantic transport across distinct technical vocabularies.

Receiver Arm C1 recovered the identical state machine, authority boundaries, lineage requirements, and temporal constraints when salient terms were replaced with arbitrary symbols (Token Zeta, Protocol Chi, Anchor Hash Psi), proving that reconstruction depends on relational topology rather than familiar English semantic tags.
